v0.5.5

Balance / 平衡性
- Prescience now costs 1 Energy instead of 0, limiting the payoff from stockpiling generated copies. / 【先见】的耗能由 0 调整为 1，限制囤积大量生成牌带来的收益。
- Forewarn now costs 2 Energy instead of 3. / 【预警】的耗能由 3 调整为 2。

Rules / 规则
- Transmuted copies created by Myriad Faces, Summon, Encore, and similar effects no longer inherit the template card's Affliction. This prevents Frozen or Soulbound from being multiplied through Transmute. / 使用【千面】、【召唤】、【返场】等效果创建的幻化复制品不再继承模板牌的 Affliction，避免通过幻化复制冻结或魂缚。
